planCriteria.criterion: Given a customer selects a 'haircut', the system reserves a 30-minute block in the calendar.
Given a customer selects a 'haircut and beard', the system reserves a 45-minute block in the calendar.
Given a customer selects 'any barber', the system assigns the appointment to the first available barber.
Given a customer selects a specific barber, the system only shows that barber's available time slots.
Given a customer completes a booking, the system sends a confirmation email containing a unique cancellation link.
Given a customer clicks the cancellation link, the appointment is removed if the request is made more than 6 hours before the start time.
Given a customer clicks the cancellation link, the system prevents cancellation if the request is made less than 6 hours before the start time.
Given a barber views the calendar, the system displays all appointments for the selected day and week.
Given a barber marks a time slot as 'time off', that slot becomes unavailable for customer bookings.
Given two customers attempt to book the same barber at the same time, the system prevents the second booking to ensure no double booking occurs.
